title: browser_memory_policy MCP tool
description: Daemon-routed. Lets an agent request a website-memory policy change. The request only takes effect after the owner confirms it in the agent client through MCP form elicitation, reusing the registerTools confirmation path in mcp-server/src/register-tools.ts. The confirmation text is built only from the action and the canonical origin; agent and page text never appear in it. Kept apart from the read-only browser_memory tool so a client can auto-allow reads while still prompting for policy changes (2026-10-27 clarification, FR-004, AC-32).

tabId.description: Required for exclude, include, inspect, export and delete (origin resolved from the tab, so tab locks apply). Rejected for enable and disable, which are not origin-scoped.

internalNote.description: ownerConfirmed is an internal wire field, never part of this input schema and never accepted from the agent — the same pattern as expectFingerprints in tools/action-support.ts. The daemon call is dispatched with an agent-supplied value of that field always dropped; only the gate's own value, set after the owner confirms through elicitation, is forwarded.

text.description: Confirms exactly the change that applied. For inspect/export, the same scope as browser_memory for that origin (AC-32).

failureCodes.description: Failures are 'CODE: message'. CLIENT_CONFIRMATION_UNAVAILABLE: the client cannot elicit the owner. ACTION_NOT_CONFIRMED: the owner declined or did not answer. Neither case changes policy, and a repeated request after either failure gets the same two outcomes — confirmed by the owner, or nothing changes.
